models_evaluated: Blood culture outcome prediction machine learning model (BC stewardship tool)

links.outcome: Monthly AUC, AUPRC, Brier score drift via SPC charts over one year
links.effect: Average AUC 0.78, AUPRC 0.41, Brier 0.10; no points outside statistical control despite a drop in hospital admission rate outside control
links.quote: The AUC, AUPRC, and Brier scores showed no statistical control violations over one year, suggesting no performance drift.

links.outcome: Silent-mode live performance versus original validation performance
links.effect: Live background AUC 0.78 vs original 0.75-0.81; AUPRC 0.41 vs prior 0.19-0.38
links.quote: The average AUC (0.78) during this follow-up is comparable to the original validations (AUCs ranging between 0.75 and 0.81), while the AUPRC (0.41) even is slightly higher (previous AUPRCs ranging between 0.19 and 0.38).

links.outcome: Performance under population shift from training cohort (higher positivity, COVID-19)
links.effect: Positivity 13.4% vs 11.5% in training, contamination 10.3% vs 6.3%, 328 COVID-19 cases; performance stayed within statistical control
links.quote: However, despite evolving practices and populations, the performance of our model consistently remained within the bounds of statistical control, negating the necessity for recalibration and indicating our model is robust to changing environments.

models_evaluated: Blood culture stewardship machine learning prediction tool

links.outcome: Temporal drift in discrimination and probabilistic prediction accuracy
links.effect: Across 3.035 visits, average AUC was 0.78, AUPRC 0.41, and Brier score 0.10; no statistical control violations occurred over one year despite changing population characteristics.
links.quote: The AUC, AUPRC, and Brier scores showed no statistical control violations over one year, suggesting no performance drift.

links.outcome: Predictive performance relative to original validation
links.effect: Follow-up AUC was 0.78 versus original validation AUCs between 0.75 and 0.81; AUPRC was 0.41 versus previous AUPRCs between 0.19 and 0.38.
links.quote: The average AUC (0.78) during this follow-up is comparable to the original validations (AUCs ranging between 0.75 and 0.81), while the AUPRC (0.41) even is slightly higher (previous AUPRCs ranging between 0.19 and 0.38).

models_evaluated: custom machine learning model for predicting blood culture outcomes

links.effect: The model achieved an average AUC of 0.78 for predicting blood culture outcomes during real-time shadow evaluation.
links.quote: The average AUC for predicting BC outcomes was 0.78 (standard deviation (SD) = 0.02).

links.effect: The performance metrics of the model showed no statistical control violations over a one-year monitoring period.
links.quote: The AUC, AUPRC, and Brier scores showed no statistical control violations over one year, suggesting no performance drift.

unlisted_practices: Using Statistical Process Control (SPC) charts for individuals and moving ranges to monitor model performance metrics and clinical outcomes over time for drift detection.
